allowed_changes: one fixed cross-market rule: if both same-calendar-date completed CSI300 and Shanghai Composite closes are above their immediately preceding real-session closes, enter U.S. equity exposure at that date's U.S. cash open
trade Nasdaq and S&P 500 as standalone 100% sleeves and as one fixed 50/50 combined portfolio
exit every U.S. position at the same U.S. session close; hold no overnight position
matched availability controls trade the identical U.S. open-to-close paths on every date where the two China signal bars and U.S. execution bars exist, but ignore the sign of China returns
one fixed 0.05% adverse-slippage-per-fill stress in addition to the 0.005% per-fill fee
comparison_gates: candidate combined Sharpe > matched China-availability control Sharpe
candidate combined CAGR > matched China-availability control CAGR
candidate combined MDD <= matched China-availability control MDD

controls.cash: C-CASH-COMBINED uses the existing CashYieldCNY demand-deposit model over the identical evaluation window
controls.matched_availability: C-CHINA-AVAILABLE trades the same U.S. open-to-close assets on every date with usable same-day China signal bars and U.S. execution bars, but removes only the China breadth sign filter

expected_outputs: Nasdaq, S&P 500 and fixed 50/50 combined candidate metrics
availability-matched controls, CNY cash control and 0.05% per-fill adverse-slippage stress
round-trip count, win rate, average net trade return, profit factor and active-session count
maximum intraday gross, minimum end-of-day cash, overnight-position audit and target fingerprint
portfolio CSV for every candidate, control and stress path
dataset hash, run authorization receipt and SHA-256 artifact manifest
follow_up_policy: After any formal performance metric is viewed, do not invert the China sign, change the two-index AND rule, add a return threshold, change signal lag, switch China or U.S. indices, add trend/volatility filters, change holding period, allocation, fee, slippage, or asset deletion inside this trial. Any such idea is a new independent preregistered strategy lineage.
forbidden_changes: reading current U.S. session high, low or close before the U.S. open entry decision
using any China observation timestamped after the U.S. cash open
testing positive, negative, thresholded or weighted China-return variants and selecting the best
changing same-day China breadth from the fixed CSI300 AND Shanghai Composite positive-close rule
adding SMA, ATR, RSI, MACD, volume, VIX, NFCI or any other filter after viewing the result
changing same-day U.S. close exit to overnight or multi-day holding
asset-specific parameters or dropping a weak Nasdaq or S&P 500 path
shorting, borrowing, financing, leverage, negative target weights, gross exposure above 100% or negative end-of-day cash
changing the 0.005% per-fill fee or hiding the preregistered adverse-slippage stress
hypothesis: A broad positive China cash-session close, observed before the U.S. cash open on the same calendar date, reflects globally persistent risk-on information and capital-flow sentiment that carries into the subsequent U.S. cash session. Buying Nasdaq and S&P 500 at the U.S. open only after both CSI300 and Shanghai Composite close higher should produce a repeatable positive open-to-close return without overnight exposure.
objective_gates: both standalone U.S. paths have Sharpe > 0
pass_fail_gates: at least 70% of seven fixed folds have combined Sharpe > 0
with 0.05% adverse slippage per fill, combined CAGR > 0 and Sharpe > 0
maximum intraday gross <=100%, minimum end-of-day cash >=0 and overnight position days =0
selection_metric: No within-family selection. There is exactly one China-breadth continuation rule. Strategy validation, objective attainment and matched-control comparison are reported separately under ATM-SVP-3.

shared_rules.china_signal: same calendar date CSI300 close > prior real CSI300 close AND Shanghai Composite close > prior real Shanghai close
shared_rules.entry: buy current U.S. session real open after the completed same-date China cash closes are known
shared_rules.time_causality: China cash close precedes U.S. cash open on the same calendar date
